lessons: Review approved the logic but each new test file had two `# clutch:meta` blocks. Write each of tests/unit/test_serve_scan_head.py, tests/integration/test_serve_scan_head.py and tests/regress_serve_scan_head.py with exactly one header, made by `uv run clutch meta refresh <file>`.

After `clutch meta refresh`, edit only the purpose line by hand. Never paste in a second header block. Before committing, open lines 1-20 of each new file to confirm there is one `# clutch:meta` block. Then run `uv run clutch meta check` on those three files (criterion 7).

Redo the clutch/serve.py `intake_snapshot` change. Compute `pending` first. Set `head` to `await c.git.rev_parse(c.repo, "main")` only when `pending` is non-empty, else None. Keep the `except OSError, GitError: return None` path. Review found this approach sound.

Criterion 5 requires tests/regress_serve_scan_head.py to print the defect result on the merge base. The stage log shows a `pass` result with exit 0 right after the regression-base worktree was built. Run the reproducer on a base-commit worktree and make it detect the head-triggered rescan there.
